```python
import json
from collections import Counter

words = "sparta rapprochement duct avocado molybdenum paterson grace nitrate aerial algiers calhoun nefarious checksum".split()
rank = lambda c: ord(c) - ord("a") + 1

groups = [
    ["aerial", "algiers", "avocado"],
    ["calhoun", "checksum"],
    ["duct"], ["grace"], ["molybdenum"],
    ["nitrate", "nefarious"],
    ["paterson"], ["rapprochement"], ["sparta"]
]

first_claims = [19, 18, 4, 1, 13, 16, 7, 14, 1, 1, 3, 14, 3]
a_words = groups[0]
c_words = groups[1]
n_words = groups[5]

checks = [
    (1, [rank(w[0]) for w in words] == first_claims),
    (2, Counter(w for g in groups for w in g) == Counter(words)
        and all(len({w[0] for w in g}) == 1 for g in groups)
        and all(groups[i][0][0] < groups[i + 1][0][0]
                for i in range(len(groups) - 1))),
    (3, [rank(w[1]) for w in a_words] == [5, 12, 22]),
    (4, a_words == sorted(a_words)),
    (5, [rank(w[1]) for w in c_words] == [1, 8]),
    (6, c_words == sorted(c_words)),
    (7, [rank(w[1]) for w in n_words] == [9, 5]),
    (8, ["nefarious", "nitrate"] == sorted(n_words)),
    (9, len({w[:2] for w in a_words}) == 1
        and [rank(w[2]) for w in a_words] == [9, 7, 3]),
    (10, ["avocado", "algiers", "aerial"] == sorted(a_words)),
    (11, "avocado algiers aerial calhoun checksum duct grace molybdenum nefarious nitrate paterson rapprochement sparta".split()
         == sorted(words)),
]

first_error = next((number for number, valid in checks if not valid), None)
evidence = {
    "correct_order": sorted(words),
    "second_letters": {w: w[1] for w in a_words},
    "actual_third_letters": {w: w[2] for w in a_words},
    "reason": "Distinct second letters already settle this group; the third-letter claims are also incorrect."
}

print(json.dumps({
    "final_answer": "No" if first_error is None else str(first_error),
    "evidence": evidence
}, separators=(",", ":")))
```
